summary: Iter 22 Web Push + PWA testing. Backend: 21/23 iter22 tests PASS + 7/7 push_service unit tests PASS. Frontend: SW registers at scope=/, NotificationSettingsPanel renders on both parent and student /account pages, notification-enable-btn click failure handled gracefully with toast (expected in headless). ONE CRITICAL bug: POST /api/push/test returns 500 (unhandled ValueError bubbles up from VAPID key deserialization inside webpush() → not caught by _send_one_sync's WebPushException-only handler).

critical.endpoint: POST /api/push/test (and any real trigger that hits _send_one_sync)
critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when a subscription exists. Backend log shows: 'ValueError: Could not deserialize key data ... ASN.1 parsing error: invalid length' raised by cryptography inside pywebpush.webpush(). Two root causes: (a) VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY in /app/backend/.env is malformed / not a valid PEM after the '\n' → newline substitution — cryptography cannot parse it. (b) push_service._send_one_sync only catches WebPushException, so ANY key-loading/serialization error escapes → 500 to the client. Even after the VAPID key is fixed, the handler should wrap the whole webpush() call in a broad try/except (Exception) and return (False, None) so operators aren't served 500s if the key config drifts.

action_items: 1. Fix VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY in /app/backend/.env — the PEM currently fails deserialization. Either regenerate a fresh EC prime256v1 key (openssl ecparam -genkey -name prime256v1 -noout -out priv.pem) and store it correctly, OR switch push_service to use the raw base64url-encoded private scalar (pywebpush accepts both). Confirm push_service._vapid_private_key() returns a value that `serialization.load_pem_private_key(...)` can parse.

2. Harden push_service._send_one_sync — replace `except WebPushException` with `except Exception as ex` so key/serialization/network errors also count as a failed send and never propagate a 500 to the API layer.
3. (nice-to-have) Add a startup sanity check that logs an error if VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY fails to load — surfaces misconfig at boot rather than at first push.
critical_code_review_comments: push_service._send_one_sync only catches WebPushException — any cryptography/import/network error bubbles as 500. Should catch Exception broadly and log.

seed_data_creation: Test inserted then deleted a fake push_subscription row for parent@demo.com during subscribe/dedupe test. No stale test data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After the VAPID key fix, re-run: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter22_push_endpoints.py tests/test_push_service.py -v`. All 30 should pass. To reproduce the 500: `curl -c /tmp/c -X POST https://.../api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"parent@demo.com","password":"demo1234"}'` then subscribe a fake endpoint, then POST /api/push/test → 500. Backend log emits the ASN.1 traceback. push_service unit tests do NOT exercise the real key path (they patch _send_one_sync), which is why they still pass.
rca of the issue: 1) VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY env var contents produce an unparseable PEM after '\n'→newline substitution — cryptography raises ValueError('ASN.1 parsing error: invalid length'). 2) push_service._send_one_sync catches only WebPushException, so this ValueError propagates out of asyncio.to_thread → out of send_push_to_user → up through the FastAPI route → 500. Fix requires BOTH regenerating/reformatting the VAPID key AND broadening the exception handler for defense-in-depth.
